records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: A quick hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Following up on my earlier notes — I don't want to crowd your inbox, so just one practical thought.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project up is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Priya
